SELECT SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-04'

SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name, is_current
FROM dim_product
WHERE sku = 101624
ORDER BY is_current DESC
